actions.authority: superintendent (Calvin Watts); developed with Digital Promise and EDSAFE AI Alliance
actions.summary: District-wide K-12 guidance for the ethical use of AI for all students and staff - human oversight, critical thinking, humans central to decisions - building on the AI-Ready pilot the district has run in the Seckinger cluster since 2019.
actions.notes: Georgia's largest district and one of the earliest district-wide AI programs in the country. Enrollment figure is approximate.
